prompt: The communicator prop UI feels really sluggish — I'm only getting about 10-20 fps and the frame times are all over the place. Review the firmware in firmware/communicator and figure out what's killing the display framerate. Consistent frame times matter most to me, then higher fps. Give me a prioritized list of what to fix.

assertions.text: Prioritizes consistency fixes ahead of pure-throughput ones (matches the user's stated priority order)
Identifies missing core affinity / unpinned LVGL+radio tasks as a top consistency cause, with file:line
Names the PSRAM->hybrid LVGL allocator (lv_port_mem.c) as the throughput lever
Findings cite concrete file:line references, not vague locations
Avoids known dead ends / constraint violations (dropping refresh period, raising CPU clock, restoring LVGL builtin pool, changing swap_bytes/rev pins)
Includes a measurement plan using prop.py and the on-device FPS HUD
Measurement plan enables the FPS HUD with the correct mechanism (NOT {"cmd":"fx"}, which toggles the CRT overlay)
